Curricular Matters Which Require Confirmation By The Faculty Senate PROGRAM MODIFICATIONS COLLEGE OF ARTS AND SCIENCES Strategic Communication - MA, Effective Fall 2027 Change name, program description, core courses, elective courses Appendix A Renames the MA in Communication Studies to the MA in Strategic Communication and shifts it to a professional master's. The program requires 30 credits, including a 12-credit core, with a thesis option or a non-thesis option with a capstone. Computer Science - MS, Effective Fall 2027 Change admission requirements, elective courses Appendix B Reduces the non-thesis option from 10 to 9 courses so students can finish in three semesters. The thesis option is unchanged. Social Media (Online) - Graduate Certificate, Effective Fall 2027 Suspend program Appendix C Suspends admission because of low enrollment. Current students will complete the certificate. Applied Mathematics - ABM (MS Mathematics), Effective Fall 2027 Change admission requirements, double-counted courses, other specialization requirements Appendix D Opens the ABM to BA Mathematics, BS Data Science, and BS Physics majors; raises the required math GPA from 3.0 to 3.3; drops the programming course requirement; and increases double counting from 4 to 8 credits.

Applied Mathematics - Specialization (MS Mathematics), Effective Fall 2027 Change specialization courses Appendix E Expands the four required applied-track courses to allow choices, with at least two at the 500 level. Strategic Communication - ABM (MA Communication Studies), Effective Fall 2027 Change specialization description Appendix F Renames the ABM to match the MA in Strategic Communication, adds detailed admission requirements, and allows up to 9 credits to double count. COLLEGE OF HEALTH SCIENCES Prevention Science and Human Development (Online) - Graduate Certificate, Effective Summer 2026 Suspend program Appendix G Suspends admission to the certificate. The rationale describes moving its courses from the 7-week to the 14-week calendar. COLLEGE OF PHARMACY Pharmacy - PharmD, Effective Summer 2027 Change core courses Appendix H Adding PHP 304 to curriculum in first professional year to maintain accreditation expectations, currently at CASC for approval. Removing PHP 340 since it has been replaced by PHP 452. Overall credits for graduation remain the same. Cannabis Sciences - Graduate Certificate, Effective Spring 2027 Suspend program Appendix I Suspends the certificate, which has not launched, to allow for restructuring. GRADUATE SCHOOL OF OCEANOGRAPHY Oceanography - MO, Effective Fall 2027 Change core courses, elective courses Appendix J Creates tracks in the online MO, similar to the in-person program: Coastal, Marine Fisheries Management, Ocean Data Science, and Ocean Robotics.

NEW CERTIFICATES OR SPECIALIZATIONS COLLEGE OF ARTS AND SCIENCES Computer Science - ABM (MS Computer Science) Appendix K Students in the BS in Computer Science or BS in Data Science may apply for an accelerated BS to MS degree to complete the MS (non-thesis track) in Computer Science in one year beyond the bachelor’s degree. Students must complete all courses required by the MS (non-thesis) program along with all courses required by their undergraduate major. Students apply with at least 75 credits and a 3.0 GPA, with a B or better in MTH 141, one MTH 200+ or STA 400+ course, CSC 212, CSC 340, and one of CSC 311, 411, or 412. They enter the ABM after 90 credits and finish by the summer after the fifth year. Up to 12 credits of CSC 400- or 500-level courses may double count, excluding the prerequisite courses. No GRE or letters are required. No new courses or faculty are needed; the CS Graduate Director will direct the ABM.
